services.name: TextNow
services.summary: Private +1 number with the highest free OTP success: Google codes in 9 of 10 attempts, Telegram in 6 of 10.

services.name: Google Voice
services.summary: Accepted by Google every time and the most stable free number. Needs an existing US number to activate.

services.name: SMSFAST
services.summary: Online number service that passed Telegram, WhatsApp and Google in our test, with numbers for the US, Canada, the UK and Australia.

services.name: Talkatone
services.summary: Good second free number. Make one call or text every 30 days or the number is reclaimed.

services.name: TextFree
services.summary: Passed some Google checks; Telegram and WhatsApp rejected every number.

services.name: Nextplus
services.summary: A few Telegram codes arrived; no Google or WhatsApp codes.

services.name: Receive-SMSS
services.summary: Public numbers with no registration. Anyone can read the code, so use it for throwaway signups only.

services.name: Quackr
services.summary: Public numbers with the widest country coverage among free sites. Expect to try several numbers.

services.name: SMS24
services.summary: Fine for low-risk websites; Telegram, WhatsApp and Google rejected almost all numbers.

services.name: AnonymSMS
services.summary: Lowest score in our test. Blocked by all three platforms.
